agro_workshops.title: Agro-Innovation Workshops
agro_workshops.subtitle: Transforming the Field with Technology and Knowledge
agro_workshops.location: Driving Sustainable Development in Cundinamarca, Fusagasugá and the Sumapaz Zone

intro.text: "Agro-Innovation Workshops" is an academic space designed to connect rural communities, organizations, companies and NGOs with the latest trends in technology applied to agriculture. Our goal is to strengthen the agricultural production chain through innovation, training and social appropriation of knowledge, aligned with national and departmental public policies of Colombia.

alignment.title: Public Policy Alignment
alignment.text1: Our project is strategically aligned with the National Development Plan (PND) 2022-2026, particularly with the "Human Right to Food" transformation, which promotes intensive data use and digital technology adoption for productive reconversion. Furthermore, we are in tune with the National System of Agricultural Innovation (SNIA), integrating local knowledge with cutting-edge technology.
alignment.text2: At the departmental level, our approach fits perfectly with the strategic lines of the Development Plan of Cundinamarca 2024-2028, especially in the commitment to "Shared Competitiveness" and "Countryside = Efficient Productivity". We work to incorporate Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) in agricultural production systems, fostering social appropriation of knowledge and strengthening technological capabilities of rural communities.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.text: Our methodology is based on Project-Based Learning (PBL) and the STEAM philosophy (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics), promoting active student participation in solving real problems. Through practical workshops, participants will learn to build and program IoT nodes for crop monitoring, automatic irrigation systems, smart alarms and environmental meters, among others.

items.title: Smart Agricultural Monitoring
items.desc: Learn to use IoT sensors to monitor critical variables such as humidity, temperature and light, optimizing production and reducing losses.

items.title: Automatic Irrigation Systems
items.desc: Design and implement irrigation systems that respond to your crops' specific needs, using low-cost and high-efficiency technology.

items.title: Smart Alarms
items.desc: Build alarms that warn you of possible threats, such as intruders or adverse weather conditions, protecting your investment.

items.title: Environmental Meters
items.desc: Install school or peasant weather stations that provide precise data for informed decision-making.

benefits.title: Benefits for Rural Communities
items: Increased Productivity: Improve crop efficiency through precise monitoring.
Cost Reduction: Minimize use of resources like water and fertilizers.
Technical Strengthening: Acquire technological skills to maintain your own solutions.
Promotion of Popular Economy: Foster technical and economic autonomy of your community.

budget.title: Budgets and Financing
budget.text: We offer a transparent cost structure and sustainable business model. We have tiered pricing levels to adapt to needs and payment capacities of our clients, from NGOs and rural unions to private companies and government entities.
budget.paymentText: We accept 70% advance payments upon contract signing, with remaining 15% at start of first module and final 15% upon completion and certificate delivery. Additionally, we offer in-kind financing through strategic alliances, such as institutional support, network access and use of spaces.

agro_workshops.conclusion: At Agro-Innovation Workshops, we are committed to sustainable development of rural communities. Join us and be part of this agricultural technological revolution.
